tool_args.rationale: The barrier-modulated siphon is a concrete archive-supported stationary alternative matching the observed increasing concave response and sink-gradient dependence. The last failure was an implementation NameError, so this turn fixes the fit/predict state handling and numerically fits its four parameters to all 10 paid rows.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous model attempt ended in a NameError, not a scientific refutation; the existing 10 rows already span input and sink-gradient values and support fitting the named stationary alternative.
Its earlier confirmation was strongly refuted (RMSE 0.640811), so retain only as a rejected alternative.
All available training rows have the same H, and there is no identified temporal signature to justify an additional trajectory measurement or a less identifiable temporal fit.
